tool.name: florida_officer_search
tool.title: Florida Sunbiz Officer and Registered Agent Search
tool.description:
Search the Florida Sunbiz registry by an officer, director, or registered-agent name and return every Florida company tied to that person, with entity name and document number.

Behavioral Transparency:
- Execution: Network call executed synchronously in the cloud via Apify Actor 'captainhandsome/fl-sunbiz-officer-search'.
- Side Effects: Strictly read-only; queries the public Sunbiz search pages.
- Authentication: Requires APIFY_TOKEN environment variable.
- Latency & Limits: Typical run duration is 10-30 seconds without detail pages, longer with include_details enabled (one extra page load per matched company); timeout capped at 120 seconds.

Usage Guidelines:
- When to use: Use to find every Florida company associated with a specific person's name (officer, director, or registered agent), for background research or ownership mapping.
- When NOT to use: Do not use to search by company name (use 'florida_new_filings_search' instead), for other states, or for contractor licences.
- Named alternatives: Use 'florida_new_filings_search' to look up a Florida company by its own name, or 'us_business_entity_search' for a multi-state company-name lookup.

search_query.description: Full or partial officer, director, or registered-agent person name to search on Sunbiz (e.g. 'SMITH' or 'Smith, John').

max_results.description: Maximum number of officer-to-entity records to return and bill. Defaults to 10.

include_details.description: When true, opens each matched company's Sunbiz detail page to add status, filing date, FEI/EIN, addresses, the full officer list, and annual-report history. Slower; leave off for a fast person-to-company lookup.

results.description: Collection of Florida officer/registered-agent-to-entity records matching the search query.

officer_name.description: Officer or registered-agent name shown in Sunbiz.

entity_name.description: Florida business entity linked to the officer or agent.

document_number.description: Florida Division of Corporations document number.

detail_url.description: Direct link to the company's Sunbiz detail page for audit against the state registry.

entity_type.description: Registry classification, such as Florida LLC or Foreign Profit Corporation (requires include_details).

status.description: Current Florida registration status, normally ACTIVE or INACTIVE (requires include_details).

date_filed.description: Date the entity was first filed with the Florida Division of Corporations (requires include_details).

principal_address.description: Principal place of business on file (requires include_details).

search_query.note: The Actor takes start_urls (an array of Sunbiz result-page URLs), not a bare search term. URL-encode search_query (e.g. urllib.parse.quote), substitute it into 'https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/SearchResults?inquiryType=OfficerRegisteredAgentName&searchTerm={value}', and wrap the single resulting URL string in a one-element list before assigning to start_urls.

verification.note: POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/captainhandsome~fl-sunbiz-officer-search/runs?build=latest&timeout=120 with {"start_urls":["https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/SearchResults?inquiryType=OfficerRegisteredAgentName&searchTerm=SMITH"],"max_items":3}; polled to SUCCEEDED; fetched 3 dataset items, all with officer_name containing 'smith' (e.g. 'smith', 'smith , brad', 'smith , joe').
